mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ai_message_photos (message_id, material_id, user_id, conversation_id) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{materialId}, #{userId}, #{conversationId})
mapper.select: SELECT message_id, material_id FROM ai_message_photos WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY message_id, material_id

SELECT p.material_id FROM ai_message_photos p JOIN course_materials cm ON cm.material_id = p.material_id AND cm.user_id = p.user_id AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE p.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.message_id = (SELECT MAX(q.message_id) FROM ai_message_photos q WHERE q.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND q.user_id = #{userId} AND q.message_id <= #{uptoMessageId}) ORDER BY p.material_id

SELECT p.material_id FROM ai_message_photos p JOIN course_materials cm ON cm.material_id = p.material_id AND cm.user_id = p.user_id AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE p.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.message_id <= #{uptoMessageId} ORDER BY p.message_id DESC, p.material_id
SELECT conversation_id FROM ai_messages WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND user_id = #{userId}
